d: With more than 14000 people around the globe, GHD is one of the world’s leading professional services companies operating in the global markets of water, energy and resources, environment, property and buildings, and transportation. Serving clients across five continents and the Pacific region, GHD people share a passion for exceeding the expectations of our clients and contributing to their success.

The Senior Transport Engineer will lead and contribute to the planning, design, and delivery of transport infrastructure projects. This role demands a strong foundation in traffic engineering, transport planning, and multi-modal design, with the ability to manage complex projects and mentor junior staff.

We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Transport Engineer to lead the design and planning of transport infrastructure projects. You will work within a multi-disciplinary team to deliver innovative, sustainable, and compliant transport solutions across roads, highways, and urban mobility systems.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Civil or Transport Engineering (Master’s preferred).
Minimum 8–10 years of experience in transport engineering, preferably in the UAE or GCC region.
Proficiency in traffic modelling tools (SIDRA, AIMSUN, VISSIM).
Strong understanding of UAE transport authority requirements.
Excellent communication, coordination, and stakeholder engagement skills.
Take on some of the world's toughest challenges- with everyone at GHD backing you every step of the way.

r: Lead the design and technical delivery of transport infrastructure projects including roads, intersections, and traffic systems.
Conduct traffic impact assessments, transport modelling, and feasibility studies.
Use software tools such as SIDRA, AIMSUN, and VISSIM for network analysis and simulation.
Ensure compliance with UAE transport regulations and international standards. A candidate with extensive experience working in Abu Dhabi with developers and ITC is preferred.
Strong working relationship with ITC and other transport authorities is essential
Collaborate with clients, authorities, and internal teams to ensure project alignment and delivery excellence.
Mentor junior engineers and contribute to team development.
Prepare technical reports, design documentation, and presentations for stakeholders.
Support tender preparation and contribute to business development initiatives.
